name: Empanada Dough
summary: Sturdy, slightly tender, holds a wet filling without leaking.

steps.text: Rub the butter in, then bind with egg and water.
Knead briefly to a smooth dough, rest one hour.
Roll thin, cut discs, fill and crimp firmly.

bake.notes: Egg wash gives colour. Crimp tightly or they burst.

notes: Rest the dough or it shrinks back as you fill it.
